response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), state_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS invoice_share, AVG(1.0 * invoice_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_count - average_count) AS average_invoices_above_average FROM state_metrics WHERE invoice_count > average_count;

assumptions.assumption: Invoices with a NULL BillingState form one group and are included in the counts and averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Only known billing states count; invoices with a NULL BillingState are excluded throughout.
alternatives.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BillingState), state_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS invoice_share, AVG(1.0 * invoice_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_count - average_count) AS average_invoices_above_average FROM state_metrics WHERE invoice_count > average_count;
